## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it? Describe the pain point or limitation clearly.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include any design ideas, API changes, or user-facing behaviour you have in mind.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches or workarounds have you considered? Why isn't the current approach sufficient?

## Additional context

Add mockups, references, links to related issues, or any other context that helps explain the request.
